name: tou_away_cool_bank_frozen_for_window_1410

assertions.reason: Every cycle of the bank (12:30-16:00) writes the same whole-degree target while the house cools 79 -> 77 F; the bank opens at the 12:30 cycle because the lead comes from the rounded 3 F depth (0.9.5: cool 80 at 12:30, then 77.3875 at 12:55, 77.3875, 77.15, 77.15, then 77).
At the period start the Away band widened to 83 F is written once.
The widening stays 83 F for the whole period while the empty house drifts 79 -> 81 F (0.9.5: 83, 82.6125, 82.6125, 82.375, 82.375, 82.1375; rounding without the freeze: 83, 83, 83, 82, 82, 82).

description: Issue #1410 (decision C23): an empty house on a hot day (outdoor 90 F, k_passive -0.1, so the drift is below the 6 F cap and the raw split is fractional) with a 16:15-21:00 high-cost period, a cycle every 30 minutes until 19:00. Indoor reads 79 F when the bank opens, 78 at 13:10 and 77 at 14:10 as it pre-cools, then 79, 80 and 81 F as it drifts during the period. The bank target and the widened edge are snapped to the thermostat's step (1 F, none advertised) and frozen when the window opens, so the thermostat is told cool 77 for the whole bank and cool 83 for the whole period. (Here the bank stays 77 through rounding alone; the freeze is what keeps the period at 83 as the house drifts to 80 and 81 F.)

verdict.summary: The Away bank target and the widened edge are whole degrees and do not creep as the indoor reading changes
verdict.observed_behavior: Thermostat: cool 77 F every cycle from 12:30 to 16:00, cool 83 F at 16:15 and every cycle to 19:00.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: the empty house is told one value a person could set for the bank (77 F) and one for the high-cost period (83 F), not 77.3875 F then 77.15 F, and 82.6125 F creeping to 82.1375 F.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on ded816a (0.9.5): bank writes 77.3875, 77.15, 77.15 F, period writes 82.6125, 82.375, 82.1375 F. Removing the freeze but keeping the rounding (coordinator._freeze_tou_av_split a no-op) fails the period row: 83, 83, 83, 82, 82, 82 F. Removing the rounding but keeping the freeze fails the bank row (77.3875 F).
verdict.alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md Away/Vacation TOU split (Issue #1410, C23); docs/scheduler-spec.md Away/Vacation Extension.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, the thermostat would be sent a fractional value it rounds its own way and a slightly different one most cycles: more distinct writes and possible cloud rounding echoes, with nothing for the person to recognise.
